_source: IISER Bhopal Central Instrumentation Facility (CIF) NMR specification
name: High-Field FT-NMR Spectrometer Suite (400 / 500 / 700 MHz)
specs: Multinuclear 1H, 13C, 15N, 19F, and 31P solution-state and solid-state magic-angle spinning (MAS) probes
Variable-temperature control (-80 °C to +150 °C) and 2D/3D correlation experiments (COSY, HSQC, HMBC, NOESY)
High-sensitivity cryoprobe configuration for low-concentration biomolecular and bioconjugate characterization
useCases: Structural elucidation of synthetic small molecules, fluorescent probes (Luminojen), and protein bioconjugation reagents (Plabeltech)
Metabolomic profiling and purity verification for pharmaceutical and agro-chemical formulations
bookingNotes: Submit sample hazard declaration and solvent details through the IICE/CIF booking request form at least 48 hours in advance.
